Subject: INTERNAL: ACME Ariba onboarding — legal redline handback + ops mapping

Team,

Looping you on ACME's onboarding ticket. Key asks attached: the customer returned an MSA with two asks that may require escalation (data residency, expanded audit retention). Summary and asks:

- Data residency (MSA §6): ACME requests that production data for Redwood-hosted services be stored only in US regions. Our standard is multi-region hosting with options to constrain on Dedicated/Private. Legal: recommend providing a narrow contractual statement that we will not replicate backups to outside the US for this account for 12 months, subject to change with notice. Can you review whether that language is acceptable?

- Audit logs (MSA §9): they're asking for 12 months searchable retention. Our default hosted retention is 90 days; Dedicated/Private can do 12 months. Proposed compromise: commit to providing exportable logs for 12 months on request for hosted accounts (with SOC2 attestation of processing), and offer Dedicated if they require real-time 12 month in-console retention.

Ops notes for Marissa/Markus: ACME's Ariba PO schema uses a nested line-id. We have a mismatch on the 'contractReference' field which ACME expects on line-level. Attached OrderForm_PO_Field_Specs.docx contains the mapping I started. Please:
  - Marissa: confirm whether we can add contractReference as an allowed line attribute in our XML mapping (low risk).
  - Markus: if ops cannot change mapping quickly, prepare a one-off normalizer script for ACME ingestion.

Please reply with one consolidated legal statement we can send back to ACME by EOD. I'm aiming to keep this to a single send so procurement can complete the Ariba acceptance tests.

Thanks — Irene

Attachments: MSA_redline_v2.pdf; Ariba_KYC_Evidence_Catalog_v1.xlsx; OrderForm_PO_Field_Specs.docx
